SELECT 'rows' k, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d2, MIN(sale_date)::VARCHAR a, MAX(sale_date)::VARCHAR b FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'vat_mismatch', COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0, '', '' FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'vat_rates_'||CAST(vat_rate AS VARCHAR)||'_'||CAST(date_trunc('month',sale_date) AS VARCHAR), COUNT(*), 0,0,'','' FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY vat_rate, date_trunc('month',sale_date)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'regions_'||region||'_'||CAST(MIN(valid_from) AS VARCHAR), COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT store_id),0,'','' FROM dim_store GROUP BY region

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, s.region AS region_was, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount, f.sales_line_id, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT region_was,
  SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END) AS aug,
  SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END) AS sep,
  COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) nd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND staff_purchase_flag THEN gross_amount END) staff
FROM lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
),
mine AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_amount) n FROM lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COALESCE(m.store_id, c.store_id) sid, m.n, c.c, m.n - c.c diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id = m.store_id
WHERE m.n IS NULL OR c.c IS NULL OR ABS(m.n - c.c) > 0.5 ORDER BY 1
